lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Ugh, it's so dark. I can't see a thing.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: And it's way too bumpy. This ride is awful.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Hey, could we make a hole in here? I can't stand the dark.
Just bear with it, everyone. They're going out of their way to transport us.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Eww! Something's stuck to me! It's all sticky!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Sorry. I spilled my drink earlier.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: When did you have a drink? I didn't notice at all.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I may not look it, but I'm actually pretty good at sneaking food, since someone I live with is always stealing my food.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: And who is this "someone?"

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Well, who do you think?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: All this talk about food is making me hungry.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Hey. Don't you have food stocked in here?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You lot are pissing me off! What do you think this is, a sightseeing train?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If you're gonna complain about the ride or food, get off.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Here, have an apple.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Apples again? I'm tired of these. Give me something else.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: There's no point being nice to you.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: It's too dark. I can't peruse my book.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Everybody off! Enough with the complaints!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: B-but you're being the loudest, Levi...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I can hear everything from outside the pouch. If we get caught, it'll be your fault, Levi.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hmm. It's quiet now.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... I've been thinking.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: If I make a light and shine it on Levi's forehead, would the whole place light up?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You really say such utter nonsense with such sincerity. Also, I told you not to call me Levi.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Ziz. It's dark.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yeah, super dark.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: A-all right. It might slow us down a bit, but I'll open it just a tad.
With a tearing sound, a crack opens up in the darkness.
Sunlight and wind come pouring through the opening,
and the sky is revealed.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yikes, we're too high up! It's kinda scary. Could you close it back up?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: The wind's too strong. My pages keep flipping on their own. Close it.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Er... o-okay.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You people are unbelievable.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Forget about them. Don't listen to them.
We are being transported aboard Ziz's Dark Matter Pouch.
Through a small hole in the pouch, our destination comes into view.
Even from afar, the grandeur of the Lift is unmistakable.
... The Lift.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: It's my first time seeing it in person. It's impressive.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: So that's where she is?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah. The Queen is there. Now that she's stolen Liliweiss's body, she's probably up there living it up, playing queen.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We're still not within firing range. Let's get a little closer.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What are you talking about? We're not here to attack her. Did you forget?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I didn't forget. I just felt the urge to take a shot after seeing the Lift.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Is she all right in the head? I think lugging all those heavy weapons around has scrambled her brain.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You wouldn't understand, since you only carry those lightweight claws around.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... I should add more claws. Maybe get eight of them.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You'd be indistinguishable from a Harvester at that point.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: ... Silence. Need I remind all of you that we're in the middle of an infiltration mission?

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: I think it'd be better if you land soon.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Agreed, otherwise you'll run the chance of being detected by anti-aircraft guns or Storm Bringer.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Land, then continue on foot.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Eh? No thanks. I hate walking. I want to take the plane.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: If you're worried about the altitude, why don't we just fly lower?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's genius.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Genius indeed.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: ... Do something about them, {AccountData.NickName}.
Ziz, just set us down somewhere suitable.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, okay. Then I'll land.
With a whoosh, I feel my center of gravity shift.
Ziz begins descending rapidly.
Moments later, we touch down on the surface, with the Lift now in sight.
Several days prior...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: About time you showed up.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You're here.
Johan. Cecil.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Long time no see.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Even though we saw each other not too long ago.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Short time no see then.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: But it's really been a long time for me, hasn't it?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Yes, it's been a while.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Huh, that's strange. I've never seen that type of weapon before.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Oh, this? It was jointly developed by Elysion and Missilis. It's incredibly powerful. The firepower packs a serious punch.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Elysion and Missilis? That's a first.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Has the situation at the Ark been resolved?
Not entirely... but a lot of it has been taken care of, yes.
Speaking of which, I've got something to tell everyone at Eden.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Okay, let's talk inside.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: After you, {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What's this? What's his angle? Why is he asking the Commander to take the lead?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... An angle? I have nothing of the sort.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Wait a second. Now that I think about it, why did New Hope come all the way out here to welcome us?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: He never does that. His social skills are practically nonexistent.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Hehehe!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Don't laugh, Cecil.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You're right. He would wait inside Eden, then act all high and mighty when we showed up.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I did no such thing.
Maybe he's actually happy to see us this time.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Is that it, Johan?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Yes. That's right.
Then how about a welcome hug?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Keep your distance. Just lead the way.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: As you all know, knowledge is important.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: After observing you all for quite some time, I, the wise Bahamut, have come to the unfortunate realization that your level of knowledge is simply abysmal.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Which is why I, the ever-brilliant Bahamut, have arranged this gathering to impart my knowledge to you all.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I call this segment: "Ask the Wise Bahamut Anything."
Not a single cheer comes from the crowd gathered in Eden's lobby.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Now then, ask me anything you're curious about.
Not a single person says a word.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Let me make this clear: ignorance is nothing to be ashamed of.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Only by facing your ignorance head-on can you ascend to greater intellectual heights.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: So do not be afraid to ask questions.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Look. We just got back from a search mission, and we're exhausted. Then you dragged us all the way out here...

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: What is this, anyway? Do you guys do this kind of thing often?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: N-no. It's the first time.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: So you have no idea how to wrap this up?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... Maybe if someone just asks a question?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Hey, hey. Behemoth. Just ask her anything.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Huh? Why me?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: You're the one who's closest with Bahamut.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Isn't Levi closer?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Then you ask, Levi.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I told you not to call me Levi.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Hurry up and ask something, Sparkles.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Don't call me that either!

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Silence during the lecture, Levi.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: How is this a lecture if you haven't said a thing?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Go ahead. Ask your questions. I, the sagacious Bahamut, am ready.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: No one leaves this room until we've had a proper question-and-answer session.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Someone do something about this. I haven't even had a chance to shower. What is this?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: *Sigh* What are we even doing here?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Who made the Ar—

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: The proper etiquette during a lecture is to raise your hand and say, "Professor Bahamut, I have a question."

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Professor Bahamut. I have a question.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Good. Now ask your question.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Who made the Ark?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: A fine question, indeed. So, you are asking who created the Ark?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: The Ark is a place where pseudohumans and humans coexist. It is underground, and quite spacious...

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: It's underground... Yes.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: She just keeps harping about it being underground.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: She's totally stalling for time right now.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hurry up and answer the question.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Very well. If you are asking who made the Ark...

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, the clever Bahamut, made it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: All right, everyone's dismissed. The speaker's a fraud, so the lecture's canceled.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Next question. I'll take the next question now.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: Is there a food that will keep you full for three days after eating one serving?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: The answer's simple. Just eat three days' worth of food in one sitting.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: ...! That's genius!

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Such is the brilliance of me, Bahamut!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You guys are having a ball, aren't you?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Wait. Where did the kid go off to again?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She went to see the sleeping princess, of course.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Marian? What, is she made of honey or something? Why's that kid always running over to see her?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Is she over there talking to herself again?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yes, same as always.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She'll be okay, right? I heard Marian's a Queen too.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yes, or at least she used to be. Right now, she's barely surviving on a pseudo-core.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... The Queen we created, and a Queen born of nature.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I shudder to imagine what would happen if those two paired up.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: So what do we do? Forcibly separate them?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... I'm sure it'll be okay?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: They're both on our side, after all.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yeah. I agree with Ziz.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Everything about Marian tells me she's on our side.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I don't get the feeling that anything bad will happen.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You're being naive.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: L-Levi, aren't you worrying too much?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... This won't do. I'm going to bring her back.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Leave her be. She wants to be there, so why do you keep making such a fuss?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Ugh... You're so overprotective.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm not being overprotective, I'm being prudent.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: If you're already this overbearing, she's going to end up rebelling.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: Agreed. Give her some freedom, and she'll grow on her own.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h_no
lines.text: That's how we raised Marian, and she turned out wonderfully because of it.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: See? I told you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I-I don't believe you. Somehow, I just don't.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Parenting is difficult, Levi. I, the ever-astute Bahamut, will teach you everything from Z to A about parenting, so ask away.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You're better off getting advice from a deer in the woods.
Leviathan grumbles as she walks away.
*Whirr*
The door across from Leviathan opens,
and a girl with a bright smile comes running out.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hehehe!
Leviathan's heart melts at the sight of the girl running toward her with arms wide open and a bright smile.
Leviathan crouches to the floor, ready to embrace the girl.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hehe!
The little girl runs right past Leviathan.
Leviathan feels anger, disappointment, and a hint of sadness.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Heh... L-Levi? Wh-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Sh-shut it.
Leviathan grumbles as she rises to her feet.
Then she looks toward where the girl ran off to.
Johan, Cecil,
and four familiar faces are making their way over.
